method: Read-only. JSON receipts only (4 MiB cap), SHA256 of small JSON receipts and bound code, stat (size, mtime) of large source and output files without opening them. No arrays loaded, no MAT or Parquet opened, no job started, nothing under converted_datasets/ written.

right_surplus_pattern.reading: Unchanged right views occur only in blocks with at least 2 more right than left cycles. This fits right cycles with no left-clock overlap, whose pelvis stayed missing before and after the fix. The receipts do not record pre-fix values per view, so this is not established.

chain: source MAT (10 subjects) + FileInfo -> inventory (335 blocks, 16,418 side-cycles = 15,825 views; see block_to_observation)
inventory -> pelvis-corrected rebuild (335 outputs; summary binds source and FileInfo hashes per block)
rebuild -> full source readback (re-hashes each rebuild output and each source MAT before comparing values)
baseline v2 + rebuild -> preservation (re-hashes both output sets; only pelvis/segment columns may differ; left views identical)
source MAT + stair force/IK .mot -> reference recovery (20 subject-conditions, 764 windows)
rebuild + recovery -> stair correction (199 outputs copied byte-identical; 136 stair outputs rewritten keeping one view per window plus 4 source-event columns)
all seven summaries -> scope gate (summary consistency only)
lineage.block_to_observation: The inventory holds 16,418 side-cycles. Treadmill and stair blocks emit one view per side cycle (l + r). The 59 sit-stand and crouch blocks have identical left and right clocks and emit one observation per left cycle, with the right side as contra columns, so their 593 right cycles are not separate views: 16,418 - 593 = 15,825 views.
lineage.observation_to_window: Stair identity mblue:<subject>_NormalizedStrides.mat:dataOut/<path>:<l|r>:column:<k> maps to recovered window (subject, path, k); the kept view letter equals the recovered reference side.
lineage.nonreference_views: Omitted view identities are listed per block in correction_summary.json; none is silently dropped.

notes: Binding keys are repository-root relative (the launcher hashes them against cwd, which defaults to the repository root); the four receipt keys carry the converted_datasets/reconversion_v2/ prefix and their hashes equal the current files (spec_validation).
The verifier binding is TO_BIND_AFTER_REVIEW: the script is not written, so this spec cannot launch until its reviewed hash replaces the placeholder.
Stage 1 needs no pyarrow. Stage 2 reads the 136 stair files of each set plus, for the overlap target, the 140 rebuild treadmill outputs and the source clocks.

Stage 2 imports pyarrow under the 768 MiB address-space cap; that import hung without single-thread settings in the reviewer test. It must run through the launcher, whose default thread_env sets OPENBLAS/OMP/MKL/ARROW/NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1, and the pilot must confirm it.
The verifier must not import contributor_tools.common.data_contract (changed in the working tree since the rebuild).
A pilot of the same bound code on one treadmill and one stair block is required before the full run (AGENTS.md).
